objectives_fil: Itanong ang pangangailangan at kung may agarang panganib. Gamitin ang kasalukuyang lokal na directory. Kung hindi tiyak ang serbisyo, kumpirmahin sa midwife o health center. Humingi ng pahintulot bago magpasa ng detalye.
objectives_en: Given an uncertain service request, use the verified local directory to connect the resident to a qualified provider and hand over essential facts with consent.
